scope: 26 explicitly named stranded members; both confirmed parent archive verdicts retained without re-judgment.
method: Inspected each member byte-for-byte, verified supplied SHA-256 values, read source and control paths, examined ZIP local/central records and bounded DEFLATE output. Ran cleave facts and atomscan before and after changes, using this worktree for traits. The parent archives and five diagnostic source entries were also scanned as context. No payload code was executed and no callback was contacted.
path_reconstruction: The Debian extractor emitted usr directly. data/usr -> ../usr restores the queue member paths and places markers beside the original extracted files.
decoding: All facts views, including decoded text, were inspected. Incidental Base64 interpretations of prose were not treated as executable obfuscation. hidden.php uses request-controlled callable dispatch, not an encoded code layer.
trait_changes: Require adjacent executable expression statements for request-import-immediate-dynamic-call. Exclude strings, comments, non-default extract flags and intervening callable rebinding; accept whitespace and an intervening comment. Keep dispatch semantics and existing composite thresholds.

Remove duplicate jsp-command-webshell and jsp-request-process-execution from the legacy exec leaf. Existing request/command composites retain coverage. Replace four ancestor selectors with the canonical runtime-exec-request-parameter atom, preserving their JSP source alternative without widening to every command-webshell trait. That atom also accepts whitespace-separated spellings. Markdown-only prose no longer establishes the removed objective atom.
Correct root-setuid-call description to include setresuid and specify the real UID argument. Preserve matcher and severity.

Add notable php-uname-command-execution under os/sysinfo/platform/kernel. Match the complete resolved command argument of a process call, rather than an unrelated literal or one contributing concatenation fragment.

positive: spaced executable dispatch with intervening comment
controls.results: Focused scans passed. Dispatch composites retain precision 7.3 and 5.3. Each of the 26 final atomscan reports has at least two hostile findings. Full make validate is the final command after this record and markers are written.

members.marker_note: Laudanum PHP command shell: no change
members.behavior: IP-filtered page reads POST command; SHA-1/session authentication gates proc_open($command). Child stdout/stderr are retained in a browser terminal with working-directory changes and command history. This is a command-shell payload, not evidence of a reverse connection. Legacy PHP syntax limits compatibility with modern PHP.

members.marker_note: Laudanum WordPress command shell: no change
members.behavior: Includes ipcheck.php for an IP filter. The if(true) command branch bypasses the copied session login; POST command is passed to proc_open and output streams populate the terminal response. The inspected include compares REMOTE_ADDR to three configured addresses.

members.marker_note: WordPress command shell: no change
members.behavior: Runs chmod ugo-w and chattr +i against __FILE__ at page load; the latter needs adequate filesystem authority. Reads request-selected cmd and hands it to executeCommand, which invokes system through ReflectionFunction/callback fallbacks or direct system/passthru. The optional reverse-shell branch uses an uninitialized $ip request key and assumes descriptor 3, so a successful reverse connection is not established.

members.marker_note: Laudanum ASP command shell: no change
members.behavior: Permits only REMOTE_ADDR 1.2.3.4, otherwise returns 404. On form submission, cmd flows from Request.Form into WScript.Shell.Exec; StdOut.ReadAll is HTML-escaped into the response. The gate restricts the operator but leaves arbitrary process execution available to that operator.

members.marker_note: JSP command WAR: remove duplicate execution findings
members.behavior: Five ZIP members include a web.xml descriptor and a 631-byte cmd.jsp. Unlike the standalone warfiles/cmd.jsp source, this embedded JSP has no IP gate: GET cmd flows directly to Runtime.getRuntime().exec(), and DataInputStream output is printed to the response. Runtime.exec(String) does not independently parse shell metacharacters.

members.marker_note: Overlapping ZIP bomb: no change
members.behavior: 45,876,952 physical bytes declare 190,023 files and 4,507,981,427,706,459 unpacked bytes. Distinct ZIP64 local records point into overlapping DEFLATE data ending at offset 34,144,784. Bounded raw DEFLATE probes confirm expanding data; the final member produced one MiB of repeated a bytes without reaching stream end. Exhaustive extraction would exhaust resources. No full extraction was attempted.

members.marker_note: Root shell stub: clarify UID-zero request description
members.behavior: main unconditionally calls setresuid(0,0,0), then system("/bin/sh"), without authorization or error checking. This is a root-preserving shell payload when deployed with existing root authority; it is not a kernel exploit or an independent unprivileged elevation primitive. The tiny source omits declarations required by strict modern C compilers.

members.marker_note: Root shell stub: clarify UID-zero request description
members.behavior: main calls setuid(0), setgid(0), then system("/bin/sh") without authentication or checking either identity change. Comments describe installing a setuid wrapper, but the source itself does not grant that permission. Existing privileged deployment is necessary for a root shell.

members.marker_note: Root shell stub: clarify UID-zero request description
members.behavior: main calls setuid(0), then execl("/bin/bash", "bash", NULL) without authorization or checking success. Existing root authority or privileged installation is needed; there is no standalone kernel exploit.

members.marker_note: PHP reverse shell: detect the launched uname command
members.behavior: POST ip/port select an outbound fsockopen target, defaulting to 10.2.2.1:8888. Optional fork/setsid detaches the PHP process. proc_open starts uname -a; w; id; /bin/sh -i, with three pipes. A stream_select loop copies socket bytes to child stdin and both child output streams to the socket.

members.marker_note: PHP reverse shell: detect the launched uname command
members.behavior: Uses the fixed callback 10.2.2.1:8888. Optional fork/setsid detaches. proc_open starts uname -a; w; id; /bin/sh -i, and nonblocking stream_select/fread/fwrite loops bridge the socket and all three child streams. This is an outbound interactive shell relay.

members.marker_note: Laudanum PHP shell payload: no change
members.behavior: The code defines an IP-filtered, SHA-1/session-authenticated POST-to-proc_open command shell with captured stdout/stderr. A missing semicolon after the $users assignment prevents PHP parsing as shipped; legacy curly-brace string indexing also limits modern PHP compatibility. Verdict describes the explicit shell payload source, not successful runtime execution of these bytes.

members.marker_note: Laudanum hidden PHP shell: require executable import/call statements
members.behavior: @extract($_REQUEST) imports attacker-selected keys into local variables using the default overwrite mode. The immediately following @die($ctime($atime)) invokes the request-selected callable on a request-selected argument and ends the response with its result. ctime=system supplies an OS-command sink, but the generic matcher establishes arbitrary callable dispatch rather than a particular command or eval API.
